title: Large Deviations for the Two-Dimensional Dean-Kawasaki Equation with Coulomb Interactions
summary:
We establish global well-posedness and a small-noise large deviation principle for the two-dimensional Dean-Kawasaki equation with Coulomb interaction $\partial_tρ^\varepsilon=Δρ^\varepsilon-
abla\cdot(ρ^\varepsilon(V*ρ^\varepsilon))-\sqrt{\varepsilon}
abla\cdot(\sqrt{ρ^\varepsilon}\circξ^{K(\varepsilon)})$, where $V=λ_V(\cos(α_V)
abla G+\sin(α_V)J
abla G)$. Here $λ_V\geq0$ is the interaction strength, $α_V$ is the interaction angle, $G$ is the mean-zero Green function of $-Δ$ on $\mathbb{T}^2$, $J$ is rotation by $π/2$, and $ξ^K$ is a finite-mode approximation of space-time white noise.…
